Definition: Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Heshbon is a city east of the Jordan, the royal city of Sihon king of the Amorites, and it marks Israel's first conquests on the way to the promised land. Israel dwelt in Heshbon and its villages, Moses names it in the charge to take the land, and Isaiah hears Heshbon crying out under the judgment on Moab.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Heshbon reminds me that God gives His people ground to stand on, one city at a time, before the whole land is theirs.
RelatedEvents: The Defeat of Sihon and Og
